entries.0aa5c72d6f806ec7: This is a single segment of the group, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, and is made up of two parts: a matching platform centered on the housing-sector vertical media 'Livin Match,' and a DX cloud that supports operational efficiency at housing-related companies. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,592 million.
